tools.name: shorten_url
tools.description: Shorten a long URL using KooLink and return a compact kool.ink short link. Use this whenever the user wants a shortened URL, a tidy link to share, or a redirect for a long destination.

tools.name: link_stats
tools.description: Get view analytics for one of the user's own KooLink short links: total and valid (fraud-filtered) views, breakdowns by device, country and referrer, plus a trailing 7-day trend. Use this to answer 'how is my link performing'.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List the user's short links with their valid view counts, most recent first. Useful to survey overall link performance or to find a code to dig into with link_stats.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "link_stats" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
